lcc_original: 水勢在地上極其浩大，普天下的高山都被淹沒了。
notes: UNV has {<WAH03605>} implicit before 天下, but LCC renders it explicitly as 普 (universal/all); per Rule 3, braces dropped and tag attached directly: 普<WAH03605>
LCC adds 被 as a passive voice marker corresponding to the pual stem (WTH8792); 被 has no independent Hebrew lexeme so it is left unannotated, with the SN tags following 淹沒了 as in UNV
H8478(under)/H8064(heavens) positional tagging on 天/下 follows UNV convention, preserving FHL's Hebrew-word-order-mapped assignment even though it appears semantically inverted in Chinese
